newsitem.title: UK: United Utilities marked down on results.
newsitem.headline: United Utilities marked down on results.

text.p: Shares in Britain's United Utilities fell on Thursday after the company announced first half profits at the lower end of expectations.

United Utilities' shares were 7p lower at 591-1/2 after the company said pretax profits for the six months ending September 30 were 223.9 million stg against 167 million stg a year ago. Analysts had forecast pretax profits in the range of 220 to 249 million stg.
"The broad numbers are reassuring. The result is not significantly below the numbers forecast," one analyst said.

"But there's a bit of a malaise in the water sector right now, and I would be surprised if I saw the share price go higher. I'm not bullish about the share price, but I believe there is a lot of value in the shares."
